⚙ SETTINGS
Performance
Disable VTT
Turns off the 3D Virtual Tabletop engine entirely. Recommended for devices with limited GPU or RAM. The VTT tab will show a placeholder instead of the live canvas. The rest of the character sheet works normally.
Reduce Animations
Disables non-essential CSS transitions, glow pulses, and particle effects across the sheet. Keeps the UI responsive on slower hardware.
Disable 3D Dice
Replaces the 3D dice animation with a simple flat number result. Significantly reduces GPU load during rolls.
Low-Quality Map Rendering
When the VTT is enabled, reduces map texture resolution and disables atmospheric effects (fog, ambient particles). Best for integrated graphics.
Display
Compact Sidebar
Reduces padding and font sizes in the sidebar to fit more content on smaller screens.
High-Contrast Text
Increases label brightness for improved readability in bright environments or on lower-contrast displays.

Settings are saved automatically and persist between sessions.

⚙ Combat Quick Reference
ACTION
Attack, Cast Sigil, Dash (double speed), Disengage, Dodge, Help (grant advantage), Hide, Ready, Use Object.
BONUS ACTION
Class features, some Sigils, off-hand attack (light weapons), Cunning Action, etc.
REACTION
Opportunity Attack (leave melee without Disengaging), Shield Sigil, Parry, class reactions.
OPPORTUNITY ATTACK
Triggered when hostile leaves your melee reach without Disengaging. One melee attack as reaction.
GRAPPLE / SHOVE
Attack action. Contested STR (Athletics) vs STR/DEX (Athletics/Acrobatics). Grapple = Speed 0. Shove = 5 ft. or prone.
RESONANCE REST
1 hour. Instability resets. RP partially restored (half). Does not restore HP.
SHORT REST
1 hour. Spend Hit Dice to recover HP. RP +½ max. Instability −1 (minimum 0).
LONG REST
8 hours. HP and RP fully restored. Instability resets. Exhaustion −1. Scar review.
⚙ Sigil Affinities
AffinitySave / StatKeywords & Notes
🔥 FIREDEX save+1 Instability per cast. Max damage die on first roll (Ruby). Explosive terrain.
💧 WATERCON saveNo Instability bonus penalty (Sapphire). Flow, cold, pressure, healing.
💨 AIRSTR saveSpeed, weather, sound, lightning variants. High-ground attack advantage.
🌿 NATURECON saveTerrain, beast control, healing. Instability stabilizer at higher levels.
✨ LIGHTWIS saveCorruption detection, oaths, truth. Directly counters Chaos affinities.
🌀 CHAOSINT save+2 Instability + Corruption risk per cast. Unpredictable. Obsidian gem.

Exhaustion Levels
1Disadvantage on Ability Checks
2Speed halved

Status Conditions
BlindedAuto-fail sight checks. Attack at disadv. Attacks vs you at adv.
CharmedCan't attack charmer. Charmer has adv on social checks vs you.
FrightenedDisadv on checks/attacks with source visible. Can't move closer to source.
GrappledSpeed 0. Ends if grappler incapacitated or forced away.
ParalyzedIncapacitated, can't move/speak. Auto-fail STR/DEX. Attacks within 5 ft. crit.
PoisonedDisadv on attack rolls and ability checks.
ProneDisadv on attacks. Attackers within 5 ft.: adv. Ranged: disadv. Stand = half move.
RestrainedSpeed 0. Attack disadv. DEX saves disadv. Attacks vs you at adv.
StunnedIncapacitated, can't move. Auto-fail STR/DEX. Attacks vs you at adv.
Resonance Drained(Alas) RP = 0. +1 Instability until next Resonance Rest.
Vein-Burned(Alas) Disadv on all Sigil rolls for 1 hour. Forced Instability suppressed.
